yaml:
apiVersion: batch/v1
kind: CronJob
metadata:
  name: backup
spec:
  schedule: 0 2 * * *
  jobTemplate:
    spec:
      template:
        metadata:
          labels:
            app: backup
        spec:
          containers:
            - name: backup
              image: alpine:3.20
              command:
                - /bin/sh
                - -c
                - echo backup
          restartPolicy: OnFailure
  concurrencyPolicy: Forbid
